description: Returns the consulting profile of a cruise line: who it suits, who it suits less, its style and fleet. Use it when the user asks which cruise line fits them or what a line is like. It does NOT return prices, offers or booking conditions.

handle.description: Consultation handle returned by a previous call (structuredContent.handle). Pass it on every call so wishes are remembered; omit it on the very first call.

language.description: Language of the answer. Defaults to the provider's language.

name: cruise_line_profile
title: Cruise line profile
